This is an Alternative Texture pack of rugs I created and can be applied to the vanilla "Blossom Rug" in game.

Once you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ installed you can purchase the "paint" tools from Robin's shop to change the textures.

I [i]HIGHLY[/i] recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14092]Furniture Placement Tweaks[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10213]Furniture Adjustment [/url]﻿to get the most out of any furniture mod.
Furniture Placement Tweaks allows you to overlap furniture (among other
features), and Furniture Adjustment allows you to move your furniture
pixel by pixel to soothe your OCD.
